name: Yugawa (Japan)
description: A yellow field charged at the centre with the Yugawa village emblem in blue: a ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised letter Z.
history: Municipal flag of Yugawa, a village in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 20 October 1976.

features.role: Yugawa village emblem — a ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised letter Z
